title: Exploding light bulbs ( shadow hawk 1 )
summary: This short text, filed under humor, is a circulated set of instructions that claims to describe a homemade incendiary booby trap disguised as a light bulb, meant to be screwed into a fixture and used to injure or kill whoever is in the room. Written in all capitals with a sign-off of 'Shadow Hawk 1' and a joking 'Have phun' closing, it presents the scheme as a tested prank or tip, though its real content is a plan for causing serious harm and a fire hazard. The text gives no reliable author, date, or publication details. Its only apparent purpose is to frighten or shock readers. It should not be treated as a usable guide or as a harmless joke, and it is catalogued here only to describe what the file contains.
